quests.desc: It's time to explore the amazing world of TextWorld! Here is how to play! Your first objective is to move south. After that, ensure that the cabinet is open. And then, retrieve the passkey from the cabinet in the vault. Then, take a trip north. Next, unlock the passageway with the passkey. After that, make absolutely sure that the passageway is ajar. And then, make an effort to venture north. That done, attempt to travel east. Then, make an effort to move south. Then, make an attempt to move east. Then, go to the north. And then, head north. And then, head west. Then, travel west. Next, try to head north. Once you do that, take a trip east. And then, go to the east. Next, pick up the sandwich from the stand inside the studio. Alright, thanks!

objective: Who's got a virtual machine and is about to play through an fast paced round of TextWorld? You do! Here is how to play! First off, make an attempt to move south. If you can get through with that, doublecheck that the cabinet is wide open. Then, pick up the passkey from the cabinet within the vault. After that, take a trip north. After that, unlock the passageway in the parlor with the passkey. Then, make it so that the passageway is open. Then, move north. And then, go to the east. Then, make an attempt to venture south. And then, make an attempt to venture east. And then, make an attempt to go north. And then, go to the north. With that done, make an attempt to take a trip west. Following that, make an attempt to venture west. Once you get around to doing that, make an effort to venture north. Then, make an attempt to move east. With that accomplished, attempt to travel east. After that, retrieve the sandwich from the stand. Once that's all handled, you can stop!
